**Status:** production invention; repository starter acceptance condition.

Deterministic blocking is the final fidelity truth for this fixture; it selects no repaint provider, repaint request, or derived appearance. Review it at a chosen 1280 by 720, 16:9 delivery raster, 24 frames per second, and sRGB output color space, and at the widest camera view in which each subject is used. A required silhouette, formation interval, raised-hand state, or 2 m group displacement that cannot be distinguished there fails even if it becomes visible in a closer diagnostic view. Unequal-scale facts need not be forced into one false master image: a cut or dissolve may distribute them, but each subject must remain distinguishable in the delivered view and review frame that owns its claim. No derived appearance may raise or replace a geometry, motion, contact, camera, timing, fidelity-tier, or prototype claim.

**Status:** production invention; applies across model and shot color allocation.

Use one primitive-3D blocking style and exactly five production swatches: dark background `#182235`, saturated SOLOIST accent `#d7b56d`, desaturated CHORUS body `#8f9d74`, desaturated GATE finish `#6f746e`, and neutral haze `#89918a`. Neutral ground introduces no authored material swatch, and no supporting subject may spend SOLOIST's reserved accent.

**Status:** production invention; applies to every represented extent.

A standing 1.8 m SOLOIST is the shared human-scale reference. Represented extents are stated in metres against that figure and the 1.7 m CHORUS member rather than against pixel count. Diagnostic views may add scale markers, while delivered views must preserve relative scale without forcing unequal subjects into one unreadable frame.

**Status:** production invention; one selected deterministic effect.

One deterministic low-contrast haze effect may occupy the declared far region of PLAZA without competing with subject silhouettes. No other visible effect is authored. A later effect requires its own settings capability, screenplay event or persistent condition, and shot acceptance rather than an implementation-only addition.

**Status:** production invention; deliberate silence for this film.

No audible content is authored. The zero-gain structural audio guide exists only to prove the delivery pipeline, and silence is a scope fact rather than a completed creative choice a later production must preserve. Any dialogue, designed sound, music, or audible ambience must begin here and receive final screenplay content before film source maps it.
